entries.title: Acts 22:1
segments: "Brothers and Father, listen to the defense which I am about to make."

entries.title: Acts 22:2
segments: When they heard that he was speaking to them in Hebrew, they were still more quiet; and Paul went on:

entries.title: Acts 22:3
segments: "I am a Jew, a native of Tarsus in Cilicia, but I was brought up in this city under the teaching of Gamaliel, and educated in accordance with the strict system of our ancestral Law. I was as zealous in God's service as any of you who are here to-day.

entries.title: Acts 22:4
segments: In my persecution of this Cause I did not stop even at the taking of life. I put in chains, and imprisoned, men and women alike--

entries.title: Acts 22:5
segments: And to that the High Priest himself and all the Council can testify. For I had letters of introduction from them to our fellow Jews at Damascus, and I was on my way to that place, to bring those whom I might find there prisoners to Jerusalem for punishment.

entries.title: Acts 22:6
segments: While I was still on my way, just as I was getting close to Damascus, about mid-day, suddenly there flashed from the heavens a great light all round me.

entries.title: Acts 22:7
segments: I fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to me 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?'

entries.title: Acts 22:8
segments: 'Who are you, Lord?' I replied. Then the voice said 'I am Jesus of Nazareth whom you are persecuting.'

entries.title: Acts 22:9
segments: The men with me saw the light, but did not hear the speaker's voice.

entries.title: Acts 22:10
segments: Then I said 'What am I to do, Lord?' 'Get up and go into Damascus,' The Lord said to me, 'and there you shall be told all that you have been appointed to do.'

entries.title: Acts 22:11
segments: In consequence of that dazzling light I could not see, but my companions held me by the hand, till I reached Damascus.

entries.title: Acts 22:12
segments: There a man named Ananias, a strict observer of our Law, well spoken of by all the Jewish inhabitants, came to see me.

entries.title: Acts 22:13
segments: Standing close to me, he said 'Saul, my Brother, recover your sight.' And then and there I recovered my sight and looked up at him.

entries.title: Acts 22:14
segments: Then he said 'The God of our ancestors has appointed you to learn his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear words from his lips;

entries.title: Acts 22:15
segments: For you shall be a witness for him to all the world of what you have just seen and heard.

entries.title: Acts 22:16
segments: And now why wait any longer: Be baptized at once, wash away your sins, and invoke his Name.

entries.title: Acts 22:17
segments: After my return to Jerusalem, while I was praying one day in the Temple, I fell into a trance,

entries.title: Acts 22:18
segments: And saw Jesus saying to me 'Make haste and leave Jerusalem at once, because they will not accept your testimony about me.'

entries.title: Acts 22:19
segments: 'Lord,' I answered, 'these people know that I used to imprison and scourge, in Synagogue after Synagogue, those who believed in you;

entries.title: Acts 22:20
segments: And, when the blood of your martyr, Stephen, was being shed, I was myself standing by, approving of his death, and took charge of the clothes of those who were murdering him.

entries.title: Acts 22:21
segments: But Jesus said to me 'Go; for I will send you to the Gentiles far away'."

entries.title: Acts 22:22
segments: Up to this point the people had been listening to Paul, but at these words they called out: "Kill him! A fellow like this ought not to have been allowed to live!"

entries.title: Acts 22:23
segments: As they were shouting, tearing off their clothes, and throwing dust in the air,

entries.title: Acts 22:24
segments: The Commanding Officer ordered Paul to be taken into the Fort, and directed that he should be examined under the lash, that he might find out the reason for their outcry against him.

entries.title: Acts 22:25
segments: But just as they had tied him up to be scourged, Paul said to the Captain standing near: "Is it legal for you to scourge a Roman citizen, unconvicted?"

entries.title: Acts 22:26
segments: On hearing this, the Captain went and reported it to the Commanding Officer. "Do you know what you are doing?" he said. "This man is a Roman citizen."

entries.title: Acts 22:27
segments: So the Commanding Officer went up to Paul and said: "Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?" "Yes," replied Paul.

entries.title: Acts 22:28
segments: "I had to pay a heavy price for my position as citizen," said the Officer. "I am one by birth," rejoined Paul.

entries.title: Acts 22:29
segments: The men who were to have examined Paul immediately drew back, and the Officer, finding that Paul was a Roman citizen, was alarmed at having put him in chains.

entries.title: Acts 22:30
segments: On the next day the Commanding Officer, wishing to find out the real reason why Paul was denounced by the Jews, had his chains taken off, and directed the Chief Priests and the whole of the High Council to assemble, and then took Paul down and brought him before them.
